2) Current price for Call of Duty on Xbox.

3) Reviews for FIFA 21 from American region.

We'll call each accordingly with correct arguments.

Let's do them sequentially? We can make multiple calls but maybe combine into one? But they want all results. We'll produce output after calling each.

Second call games_price_find with game="Call of Duty", platform="Xbox".

Third call games_reviews_find with game="FIFA 21", region="America". Probably "Americas"? They said "American" region. Use "America" as region param.
